chunks: Safwan ibn Mihran al-Jammal said: I saw Aba Abdillah عليه السلام, when he had prayed and finished his salat (prayer), raise his hands above his head.

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: A title referring to Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.صَفْوَانُ: Safwan, the narrator reporting what he personally witnessed

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام do after finishing salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith reports an observed practice of Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام after completing salat (prayer). It indicates a post-prayer devotional act in which he raised his hands above his head, connecting the narration to ta'qib and du'a after prayer.
